title: Every direction so far
question: All sketched directions from the nine rounds, plus the six text-only ones. Pick the one with the most potential and I'll take it from there (wordmark, the motto, modest copy, student photos and the electric brand applied). Use Steer to combine two, e.g. 'Live Circuit hero with On Tour prints'.
